title: cpaic's diagonal-weight edge influence against refitted references
question: Does the diagonal-weight influence that cpaic's edge_influence() reports rank studies the way refitted leave-one-study-out references do, once multi-arm covariance and re-estimated heterogeneity enter?
design: Random four-treatment networks of 8 or 16 studies, two-arm only or with three-arm studies, tau 0 to 0.3; diagonal influence against leave-one-study-out variance importance and estimate change with tau re-estimated. 12 cells, 500 networks each.
